title: Merge process for automations is very tedious
summary: For security reasons, we have to use a fine grained token for renovate, compliation of agentic workflows, version bumps, otel deployment. current state: the codeowners forces the right approval requests, BUT *) the repo owner cant approve themselves because the are done under his token *) after rebases the right review requests are not rerequested possible solutions and why they dont work: *) agentic autoapprove workflow that identifies the right PRs doesnt work because the approval would come from github-actions app, and that app is not (and cannot be because apps simply cannot) be the codeowner *) running an agentic workflow just to rerequest the right reviews is very expensive *) changing all automations do be done as per the github-actions bot and then auto approving all PRs from that author doesnt work because anything done by the github-actions bot will not trigger workflows for "safety" reasons *) the rebaseWhen property of renovate is set to behind and cannot be changed because then conflicts would never auto-resolve. this is technically not a blocker and could be changed, but it only trades slightly less review rerequests against manual conflict resolution *) app users are not possible because creating installation tokens (via actions) auto expire at the end of a job run. we would need to create installation tokens that dont expire for at least a few days *) a single app where the private secret is in the .github.io repo to create installation tokens and put them into the repos would work, but they auto-expire after one hour. which is way too little. if we rotate the tokens once a day, they need at least 2-3 days expiry *) giving the user of the token bypass permissions is actually hurting, because it doesnt just ignore approvals and bypasses, it also ignored CodeQL checks and tests. it completely bypasses all checks. *) no codeowners would allow for github action approvals via an agentic workflow, BUT normal PRs title: Frustrating Entry System for Foods, Meals, and Recipes
summary: The results for something like white bread brings up stuff like sourdough and searching italian sausage brings up meals made with it. You shouldn't have to know the exact brand to find the food you are looking for.

title: Cannot delete a single diary item without removing/re-adding the whole entry
summary: When a diary entry has multiple items logged together (e.g. a meal with 10 foods), there's no way to remove just one incorrect item. The only workaround is deleting the entire set of items and re-adding all of them minus the wrong one, which is tedious and error-prone for meals with many items. Would it be possible to add a swipe-to-delete or a delete button on each individual diary item row, instead of only being able to clear a whole meal/entry at once?
